basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Project Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 is for 1 Project Manager post in the Department of Management Studies. The appointment is on a contract basis. Indian nationals should email the filled Form No. IRD/REC-4 to [email protected] by 5.00 p.m. on 10 November 2026. The Industrial Research & Development Unit of the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, Hauz Khas, New Delhi, issued Advertisement No. IITD/IRD/307/2026 on 26 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Project Manager at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go by email only, using the institute's own form. Send them by 5.00 p.m. on 10 November 2026. Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website of IIT Delhi (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec). Fill in the form completely. Give your educational qualifications with the percentage of marks or division, and the details of your work experience. Email the filled form to [email protected] by 5.00 p.m. on 10 November 2026. For questions about eligibility, the notice tells candidates to write to [email protected] and not to contact Prof. P. Vigneswara Ilavarasan, the Project Investigator, directly.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from Indian nationals for 1 Project Manager post. The eligibility conditions printed in the notice are listed below. Educational Qualification: MBA degree with First Class from a recognised university/institution. Experience: A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in administrative and management-related activities, preferably in an educational institution. Skills and Competencies: Good communication and public relations skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (particularly MS Word). Experience in administrative coordination, office management, record maintenance and organisational support. Preferred Profile: An experienced Management Assistant with a strong background in administration, excellent interpersonal skills, public speaking abilities and the capacity to coordinate multiple administrative activities efficiently. Relaxation: SC/ST candidates may be given a 5% relaxation of marks. Pay: The consolidated fellowship/pay-slab for the Project Manager post is Rs. 64,260 - 66,190 - 68,180 - 70,220 - 72,330 - 74,500 - 76,730 - 79,030 - 81,400 - 83,840/- p.m. HRA is paid on top of this at 30%. If a retired or superannuated government employee is selected, his or her salary will be fixed as per the prevailing IRD norms. Terms: This is a project appointment on a contract basis with consolidated pay. It is renewable every year, or lasts up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The project runs up to 21/08/2036. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: shortlisting, then an offline interview. Shortlisting: IIT Delhi reserves the right to set higher criteria for shortlisting, choosing from candidates who meet the advertised qualification and the requirements of the project post. Offline interview: The names of shortlisted candidates will be shown at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted, along with the offline interview details. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed about the offline interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 for Project Manager?
faq.answer: Advertisement No. IITD/IRD/307/2026 has 1 Project Manager vacancy in the Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Project Manager post?
faq.answer: The filled application must be emailed by 5.00 p.m. on 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIT Delhi Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBA degree with First Class from a recognised university/institution. They also need a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in administrative and management-related activities, preferably in an educational institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Delhi Project Manager?
Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the IIT Delhi Project Manager pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives HRA at 30% in addition to the consolidated pay-slab.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIT Delhi Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec. Fill it in with your qualifications (percentage of marks or division) and work experience, then email it to [email protected] by 5.00 p.m. on 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIT Delhi Project Manager post?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi may set higher criteria to shortlist candidates. The shortlisted names will appear at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted with the offline interview details, and only shortlisted candidates will be informed about the offline interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT Delhi Project Manager post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract project appointment with consolidated pay. It is renewable every year, or lasts up to the duration of the project (up to 21/08/2036), whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. SC/ST candidates may be given a 5% relaxation of marks.

faq.question: Q10. Whom should I contact about eligibility for the IIT Delhi Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Write to [email protected]. The notice asks candidates not to contact Prof. P. Vigneswara Ilavarasan, the Project Investigator, directly.
